name: The Lake
description: A miles-wide saltwater lake where the Devotion dwells.

description_citations.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
description_citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: By the lake the next morning, Dina tells Basil that grief eats you up no matter what and does not end, it only declines.
timeline.quote: Grief eats you up no matter what."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: On the third night Basil goes with Mertyn's revenant to the lake and Dina and the others follow.
timeline.quote: Then Mertyn held out a hand gloved in thin leather, and Basil took it

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: The Devotion rises from the lake and attacks, and Mertyn's revenant vanishes once he is no longer needed.
timeline.quote: left behind a vast watery form, a vaguely human shape with a mossy skull buried in its head.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Morphia frees herself with a root talisman and, with Lorenin, uses a bit of volcanic rock to calm the water.
timeline.quote: Morphia flung herself through the water that weighed down her heavy gown

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: The Devotion lifts Morphia and Lorenin out of the water, and Basil's green ray strikes its skull, dissolving the Devotion and freeing them.
timeline.quote: And then she saw a ray of green light, shooting so fast from Basil's hands

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Basil takes the Devotion's skull to the lake, gently places it back in the water, and says he no longer wants to be a mage before walking away alone.
timeline.quote: "I just don't want to be a mage anymore," he said

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
